title: SPOT THE BALL: A Benchmark for Visual Social Inference

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the Center Ratio (CR) by comparing the ratio of model prediction mass to ground-truth mass in the central window of the image grid to identify default-to-center guessing heuristics.

Measuring the Near Player Rate (NR) and Overlap Rate (OR) to determine the fraction of model predictions that fall within a fixed distance threshold or intersect with player bounding boxes, detecting over-reliance on guessing near players instead of tracking gaze.
